# Chatter Trust and Security Checklist: Chatter and Model-Enabled Rivet Scenarios

**Purpose**: Review whether requirements fully and unambiguously define private-source trust, safe conversion, data-only serving, evidence, isolation, and distribution boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-08-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command as a formal PR-review requirements gate. It evaluates the writing, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are source ownership, support boundary, immutable repository/data/recipe/membership identities, and terms all required before real-package approval? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are every unsafe input class—Joblib, pickle, estimator objects, source code, training environments, arbitrary repository files, native code, plugins, and remote code—explicitly inside or outside the rejection policy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK003 Are conversion requirements defined separately for source acquisition, trusted retraining, export, parity, packaging, import, testing, readiness, and enablement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 Are redistribution, offline export, application distribution, Git, logs, evidence, caches, and container-layer handling specified for private model/data bytes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-026, §FR-035–FR-036, §SC-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is “data-only serving representation” defined with an exact allowlisted format, content classes, numeric semantics, and validation ceilings rather than a subjective safety label? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005; Plan §Serving format and adapter]
- [x] CHK006 Is “explicit trusted conversion” distinguished unambiguously from normal installation and from any operation Wright may run unattended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-036]
- [x] CHK007 Are the exact conditions that create a new package revision enumerated without permitting mutable in-place evidence or threshold changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Are internal-use and non-redistributable terms presented as a conservative default rather than an inferred public license grant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are the source-record visibility requirements consistent with the prohibition on offering install/enable before exact local conversion evidence exists? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 Are generated normal-gate fixtures consistently separated from real Chatter qualification and prevented from satisfying real-package success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-035–FR-036, §SC-001–SC-003, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK011 Do model-library import/export requirements align with private access and artifact-level redistribution prohibitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §SC-002; Plan §Trusted qualification and package]
- [x] CHK012 Are resource ceilings consistent across package metadata, adapter validation, inference admission, scenario preflight, performance goals, and record bounds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-029, §NFR-001, §NFR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are parity thresholds numeric, directionally explicit, population-bound, and subordinate to mandatory boundary-vector agreement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Can readiness be objectively derived from artifact verification, runtime compatibility/health, parity evidence, and mandatory vectors with no unstated reviewer discretion? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK015 Are distribution-hygiene criteria objectively scoped to Git, wheels, source archives, native artifacts, Docker layers, ignored state, and payload signatures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are dependency/seed/feature-order/precision/exporter changes, parity aggregate versus boundary disagreement, and stale evidence covered as distinct exception scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007–FR-008]
- [x] CHK017 Are malformed NPZ/archive members, object arrays, non-finite preprocessing/tree values, invalid topology, class-order changes, and resource bombs covered by requirements or explicitly delegated to an existing contract? [Coverage, Plan §Serving format and adapter]
- [x] CHK018 Are interruption, cancellation, partial conversion output, failed packaging, and cleanup/residue requirements defined for the trusted qualification path? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-030, §FR-036, §NFR-007]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK019 Are the private source, local dataset, Data Vault recipe/evidence, qualification environment, and owner-terms assumptions documented with a fail-closed outcome when any is absent? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Is the separately reviewed runtime dependency specified without implying that model installation may install or mutate that runtime? [Dependency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Record any unresolved ambiguity beside the item and remediate the source requirement before implementation.
